# Reproject to EPSG:32643

schools = schools.to_crs(32643)
hospitals = hospitals.to_crs(32643)
# Filter taluks to Ernakulam or Alappuzha

# Spatial join schools to taluks to get taluk name

# Compute nearest hospital distance for each school
from shapely.ops import nearest_points
# Build spatial index for hospitals
hosp_idx = hospitals.sindex
# Function to get nearest distance

    nearest_geom = possible_matches.geometry.iloc[0]
